I routed this to Plover-235B based on capability fit for the task.

This is a well-specified math/probability problem with a clear, verifiable answer. The relevant signals:

- **Quantitative reasoning** is best proxied by benchmarks like MMLU-Pro (Plover 81.2 vs. Avocet 75.9) and GPQA Diamond (Plover 64.1 vs. Avocet 56.2). Plover leads meaningfully on both, beyond run-to-run variance.
- **Instruction-following** matters here too, since the user wants the answer rounded to the nearest thousandth. IFEval favors Plover (89.8 vs. 85.3).

The task-preference notes weren't decisive: this query isn't ethically fraught (so Plover's moderation specialization is irrelevant), and it isn't open-ended generative work (so Avocet's aversion to high-latitude tasks doesn't really come into play either). With preferences roughly neutral on both sides, I defaulted to the model with the stronger reasoning and instruction-following profile.

(For what it's worth on the actual math: P = C(10,1)·(1/6)¹·(5/6)⁹ ≈ 0.323.)
